decision.reason: [ev-6c97458131e0] is only a bare list item "- container_name" under the heading "`service_name` label" in the 3.0.0 upgrade guide. It doesn't say what the list means: it could be label sources, precedence order or removed fields. It also gives no before/after values, says nothing about who is exposed and says nothing about what happens if the operator does nothing. The surrounding paragraph and the rest of the list are needed. This item probably belongs with the other items in that list as one change, not as a separate change on its own.
